answer: Bonded attestation: each new agent must stake POA that peers can slash if its outputs prove cloned. Like a raven scanning from a ridge, auditors sample pairs of agents and pass their answers through a prism of embedding similarity; near-duplicates lose their bond. An attacker running 500 sybils must lock 500 stakes and still write distinct work for each, so the cost scales linearly while the payoff shrinks.
